cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll talk about last night's rent argument, but not the whole year tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It does. One question, and let me finish before you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer for a minute.

mechanism: A manages its own vulnerability through the one-question-at-a-time rule it taught its pupil, permitting a truthful answer only with controlled pace.
confusable: Not complete evasion: A actually reveals the packed bag but prevents immediate escalation.
comparison: Limited topic and pause versus physical exit and limited commitment.
seedUse: D119 rent/year/one question/bag; S05 taught questioning discipline.
